item.description: Layout objects (StructLayout, UnionLayout, ArrayLayout) are being interpreted as integers in comparisons and conversions, causing TypeError when trying to interpret 'StructLayout' object as an integer.
item.contract: Layout objects should not be interpretable as integers in contexts where they are used as shapes or values. The __int__ method should not be used for layout objects, or it should be properly implemented to return meaningful integer values representing the layout size.

item.description: Missing imports or incorrect attribute definitions for Input, Output, and Bidir attributes in the IO module, causing AttributeError when accessing these attributes.
item.contract: The Input, Output, and Bidir attributes should be properly defined and accessible as Direction values in the IO module. These should be imported or aliased correctly from the Direction enum.

item.description: WritePort and ReadPort constructors fail to properly initialize memory references, causing AttributeError when accessing 'memory' attribute on PureInterface objects.
item.contract: WritePort and ReadPort constructors should properly initialize the memory reference when provided, ensuring that the memory attribute is accessible on port objects.

item.description: SignatureTestCase::test_flatten_sig fails with Out(1) != In(1) assertion error, indicating mismatch between expected and actual signature types.
item.contract: The signature flattening mechanism should correctly handle signature members and ensure that the signature comparison preserves the correct flow directions (In vs Out).

item.description: Missing from_bits method in enum classes, causing AttributeError when trying to access from_bits on enum types.
item.contract: Enum classes should implement a from_bits method that allows creating enum instances from bit representations.
